summary: First pass of the fuller enumeration (layer 3). The Foreword and chapter 1 were read in full and every concrete, checkable recommendation was matched against the existing key objectives. Seventeen further recommendations were researched, independently reviewed and scored blind for significance by two AI raters: 12 from the Foreword and 5 from chapter 1. One chapter 1 candidate (Domestic Policy Council and National Security Council coordination on border security, page 40) was dropped in review as already covered by c01-02. The new records are held off the page and out of the headline counts until the fuller enumeration is shown as a separate figure; they are included in the public data file.
